verdict.rationale: Fireworks AI is an inference and fine-tuning platform. It could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, such as suggestions on usage or datasets, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only developer building blocks: inference APIs, tool calling, structured outputs and embeddings, which developers use to build such features themselves. The guided fine-tuning flow plans a training run and is not an insights feature, so no evidence shows the product delivering AI-generated insights or suggestions from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
